evidence_items.explanation: The CFO identifies both repurchases and strategic investments as offsets to cash growth. Reconciliation using e2 reproduces approximately 95% only by combining investing and financing outflows, including substantial payments to Nvidia shareholders.

metric_scope.metric: Estimated net cash generation after investment and financing outflows and its attribution to circular financing

inputs: e2: Operating cash inflow USD 50,344 million.
e2: Net investing outflow USD 26,429 million.
e2: Net financing outflow USD 21,283 million.
e2: Share repurchase payments USD 19,312 million; dividends USD 243 million.
derived.formula: Combined outflow absorption = (26429 + 21283) / 50344 × 100 = 94.772%. Investing outflow alone = 26429 / 50344 × 100 = 52.497%. Cash remaining after investing = 50344 − 26429 = 23915 million. Cash remaining after both categories = 50344 − 26429 − 21283 = 2632 million.
derived.rounding: Ratios rounded to 94.8% and 52.5%; dollar calculations retain reported millions.
